title: Multiple static blocks in one class
answer: Yes. A class can declare multiple static initialization blocks. During class initialization, static field initializers and static blocks execute once in textual order. Multiple blocks are legal but can make initialization harder to follow if logic is scattered, so cohesive initialization is usually clearer. The order is based on source order within the class, not on method-call order.
